claims.text: Many reviewers report the base or screw connection is loose, stripped, or poorly made, causing instability.
Several reviewers say the holder is unstable or falls over during use.
Some reviewers find it easy to assemble and useful for holding or drying brushes upside down.
A few reviewers note brushes do not stay straight in the gripping holes and lean or flop.
Some reviewers describe the product as cheaply made or not worth the money.
